34502.meaning1: who took refuge in Buddha and Dhamma
34502.commentary: (VINa) dve vācā etesaṃ ahesun'ti dvevācikā. atha vā dvīhi vācāhi upāsakabhāvaṃ pattā'ti attho.

34504.construction:
dva > dve + dhā + *ka
dvedha > dveḍha > dveḷha + *ka

34505.synonym: kaṅkhanīya, kaṅkhāṭṭhāniya, kaṅkhāṭhāniya, kaṅkhāṭhānīya, vematika, sakaṅkha
34505.commentary: (DNt) tato'pi appataraṃ evaṃ nu kho, na nu kho'ti-ādinā dvidhā viya pavattaṃ dveḷhakaṃ. dvidhā ela'ti kampati cittam'etenā'ti hi dveḷhakaṃ hapaccayaṃ, sakatthavuttikapaccayañ'ca katvā, tena jāto, taṃ vā jātaṃ yassā'ti dveḷhakajāto.

34506.meaning1: (gram) letter dh; 27th letter of the alphabet; dental consonant

examples.text: 18. do dhassa ca.
sare pare dhassa kvaci do hoti.

34508.meaning2: fire that is one worthy of gifts

34509.meaning2: gift, donation; fee; benefit or merit of a gift

34510.meaning2: on the south or right side; to the south

examples.text: soṇā dhaṅkā siṅgālā ca, ye c'aññe santi dāṭhino, ajarā nūna hessanti, bhakkhayitvā pabhāvatiṃ.

34512.meaning2: with the appearance of a crow

34513.commentary: (SNa) dhajo rathassā'ti mahantasmiṃ hi saṅgāmasīse dūrato'va dhajaṃ disvā, asukarañño nāma ayaṃ ratho'ti ratho pākaṭo hoti.

examples.text: bhāsaye jotaye dhammaṃ, paggaṇhe isinaṃ dhajaṃ, subhāsitadhajā isayo, dhammo hi isinaṃ dhajo'ti.
dhajo rathassa paññāṇaṃ, dhūmo paññāṇam'aggino, rājā raṭṭhassa paññāṇaṃ, bhattā paññāṇam'itthiyā'ti.

34515.meaning1: top of a standard; crest of a banner
34515.commentary: (ANa) dhaj'aggan'ti hatthi-ass'ādīnaṃ piṭṭhesu vā rathesu vā ussāpitānaṃ dhajānaṃ aggaṃ.

examples.text: bhūtapubbaṃ, ānanda, rājā mahāsudassano tam'eva maṇiratanaṃ vīmaṃsamāno caturaṅginiṃ senaṃ sannayhitvā maṇiṃ dhaj'aggaṃ āropetvā ratt'andhakāra-timisāya pāyāsi.

34516.meaningLit: discourse on the crest of a banner

34518.meaning1: adorned with flags; covered in banners
34518.commentary: (THa) dhajālū'ti tattha tattha niyyūhasikhar'ādīsu patiṭṭhāpitehi yaṭṭhidhaja-paṭākadhaj'ādi-dhajehi sampanno.

examples.text: sahassakaṇḍo satageṇḍu, dhajālu haritāmayo, anaccuṃ tattha gandhabbā, chasahassāni sattadhā'ti.

34519.meaning1: wife captured in war; woman taken in a raid
34519.meaning2: captured in war, taken as a booty
34519.commentary: (VINa) dhajena āhaṭā dhaj'āhaṭā, ussitaddhajāya senāya gantvā paravisayaṃ vilumpitvā ānītā'ti vuttaṃ hoti, taṃ koci bhariyaṃ karoti, ayaṃ dhaj'āhaṭā nāma.

examples.text: dasa bhariyāyo, dhanakkītā chandavāsinī bhogavāsinī paṭavāsinī odapattakinī obhaṭacumbaṭā dāsī ca bhariyā ca kammakārī ca bhariyā ca dhaj'āhaṭā muhuttikā.
nadato parisāyaṃ te, vādīdappāpahārino, ye te dakkhanti vadanaṃ, dhaññā te narapuṅgava.
idha, visākhe, mātugāmo yaṃ bhattā āharati dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā taṃ ārakkhena guttiyā sampādeti, tattha ca hoti adhuttī athenī asoṇḍī avināsikā.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave ubhatomukhā putoḷi pūrā nānāvihitassa dhaññassa seyyath'idaṃ sālīnaṃ vīhīnaṃ muggānaṃ māsānaṃ tilānaṃ taṇḍulānaṃ
nānākulassa dhaññakaraṇaṃ hoti parikkhittañ'ca. antodhaññakaraṇe cīvaraṃ nikkhipitvā dvāramūle vā vatthabbaṃ, hatthapāsā vā na vijahitabbaṃ.

34526.meaning1: mass of grain; hoard of crops

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, gahapati vā gahapatiputto vā aḍḍho mahaddhano mahābhogo, nekānaṃ nikkhagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ dhaññagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ khettagaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ vatthugaṇānaṃ cayo, nekānaṃ bhariyagaṇānaṃ cayo

34529.meaning2: measure of length (7 ūkā = 1 dhaññamāsa; 7 dhaññamāsa = 1 aṅgula)

examples.text: punappunañ'c'eva vapanti bījaṃ, punappunaṃ vassati devarājā, punappunaṃ khettaṃ kasanti kassakā, punappunaṃ dhaññam'upeti raṭṭhaṃ.

34531.meaning1: heap of grain; pile of corn

examples.text: āgantukassa bhattaṃ āgantukabhattaṃ, methunā apeto methun'āpeto, corā bhayaṃ corabhayaṃ, rañño putto rājaputto, dhaññānaṃ rāsi dhaññarāsi, rūpe saññā rūpasaññā, saṃsāre dukkhaṃ saṃsāradukkhaṃ.

34532.commentary: (SNa) dhaññena ca samaṃ dhanaṃ nāma n'atthi. (yadā hi sattā dubbhikkhā honti), tathārūpe hi kāle hiraññasuvaṇṇ'ādīni gomahiṃs'ādīni'pi dhaññaggahaṇatthaṃ dhaññasāmikānam'eva santikaṃ gahetvā gacchanti.

examples.text: n'atthi attasamaṃ pemaṃ, n'atthi dhaññasamaṃ dhanaṃ, n'atthi paññāsamā ābhā, vuṭṭhi ve paramā sarā'ti.

34533.commentary: (MNa) dhaññasamavāpakan'ti dhaññañ'ca samavāpakañ'ca. tattha dhaññaṃ nāma kudrūsako. samavāpakan'ti lābubījakumbhaṇḍabījak'ādi bījajātaṃ. naparamarūpan'ti yathā puññavantānaṃ gandhasālibīj'ādi parisuddhaṃ bījaṃ, na evarūpaṃ.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, udāyi, puriso daliddo assako anāḷhiyo, tass'assa ekaṃ agārakaṃ oluggaviluggaṃ kāk'ātidāyiṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā khaṭopikā oluggaviluggā naparamarūpā, ekissā kumbhiyā dhaññasamavāpakaṃ naparamarūpaṃ, ekā jāyikā naparamarūpā.

34536.meaning1: remembered; retained in mind; known off by heart
34536.meaning2: kept in mind, known by heart
34536.commentary: (ANa) dhātā'ti dhātā paguṇā. ekaccassa hi uggahitabuddhavacanaṃ dhātaṃ paguṇaṃ niccalikaṃ na hoti, asukaṃ suttaṃ vā jātakaṃ vā kathehī'ti vutte, sajjhāyitvā saṃsanditvā samanuggāhitvā jānissāmī'ti vadati. ekaccassa dhātaṃ paguṇaṃ bhav'aṅgasotasadisaṃ hoti, asukaṃ suttaṃ vā jātakaṃ vā kathehī'ti vutte uddharitvā tam'eva katheti. taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ dhātā'ti.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco puggalo khippanisantī ca hoti kusalesu dhammesu, sutānañ'ca dhammānaṃ dhārakajātiko hoti, dhatānañ'ca dhammānaṃ atth'ūpaparikkhī hoti attham'aññāya dhammam'aññāya, dhamm'ānudhammappaṭipanno hoti.

ye te dhammā ādikalyāṇā majjhekalyāṇā pariyosānakalyāṇā sātthā sabyañjanā, kevalaparipuṇṇaṃ parisuddhaṃ brahmacariyaṃ abhivadanti, tathārūpā'ssa dhammā bahussutā honti, dhatā, vacasā paricitā, manas'ānupekkhitā, diṭṭhiyā suppaṭividdhā.

34537.meaning1: name of one of the four great kings; ruler of the east
34537.meaning2: name of one of the four great kings
34537.commentary: (DNa) dhataraṭṭho gandhabbarājā gandhabbadevatānaṃ koṭisatasahassena parivuto koṭisatasahassasuvaṇṇamayāni phalakāni ca suvaṇṇasattiyo ca gāhāpetvā puratthimāya disāya pacchimābhimukho dvīsu devalokesu devatā purato katvā nisinno.

examples.text: cattāro ca mahārājāno catuddisā nisinnā honti, puratthimāya disāya dhataraṭṭho mahārājā pacchimābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā, dakkhiṇāya disāya virūḷhako mahārājā uttar'ābhimukho nisinno hoti deve purakkhatvā

34538.meaning1: name of two of the seven Bharata kings
34538.meaning2: name of two of the seven Bharata kings

examples.text: sattabhū brahmadatto ca, vessabhū bharato saha, reṇu dve dhataraṭṭhā ca, tadāsuṃ satta bhāradhā'ti.
pamādam'anuyuñjanti, bālā dummedhino janā, appamādañ'ca medhāvī, dhanaṃ seṭṭhaṃ'va rakkhati.
ārogyaparamā lābhā, santuṭṭhiparamaṃ dhanaṃ, vissāsaparamā ñāti, nibbānaṃ paramaṃ sukhaṃ.
añña'd'atthu pañjaliko'va naṃ yācati, dehi me, mārisa, urabbhaṃ vā urabbhadhanaṃ vā'ti.
saddhādhanaṃ sīladhanaṃ, hirī ottappiyaṃ dhanaṃ, sutadhanañ'ca cāgo ca, paññā ve sattamaṃ dhanaṃ.

34542.meaningLit: ought to be done with wealth

examples.text: so kismiñci'd'eva dhanakaraṇīye samuppanne na sakkuṇeyya upanīhātuṃ dhanaṃ vā dhaññaṃ vā rajataṃ vā jātarūpaṃ vā.

34543.meaning1: (of a wife or servant) purchased with money; bought with cash
34543.commentary: (VINa) appena vā bahunā vā dhanena kītā dhanakkītā. yasmā pana sā na kītamattā eva saṃvās'atthāya pana kītattā bhariyā, tasm'āssa niddese dhanena kiṇitvā vāsetī'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: dasa bhariyāyo, dhanakkītā chandavāsinī bhogavāsinī paṭavāsinī odapattakinī obhaṭacumbaṭā dāsī ca bhariyā ca kammakārī ca bhariyā ca dhaj'āhaṭā muhuttikā.
sace tasmiṃ khaṇe n'āgacchasi, āṇaṃ te karissāmī'ti. sevako kira catūhi'pi dāsehi patikiṭṭhataro. dhanakkīt'ādayo hi dāsā sīsaṃ me rujjati, piṭṭhi me rujjatī'ti vatvā acchituṃ labhanti'y'eva.
tato kāyena vācāya, vadhaṃ katvāna kodhano, kodh'ābhibhūto puriso, dhanajāniṃ nigacchati.

cha kho'me, gahapatiputta, ādīnavā jūtappamādaṭṭhānānuyoge. jayaṃ veraṃ pasavati, jino vittam'anusocati, sandiṭṭhikā dhanajāni, sabhāgatassa vacanaṃ na rūhati, mitt'āmaccānaṃ paribhūto hoti, āvāhavivāhakānaṃ apatthito hoti, akkhadhutto ayaṃ purisapuggalo n'ālaṃ dārabharaṇāyā'ti.
yathā iṇan'ti-ādīsu iṇasadisaṃ bandhanasadisaṃ dhanajānisadisaṃ kalisaṅkhāta-mah'āparādha-sadisañ'ca katvā attano abhimukhassa patodassa ajjhoharaṇasaṅkhātaṃ patanaṃ vipassatī'ti attho.

34548.commentary: (SNa) dhanañ'jānī'ti dhanañ'jānigottā. ukkaṭṭhagottā kir'esā. sesabrāhmaṇā kira brahmuno mukhato jātā, dhanañ'jānigottā matthakaṃ bhinditvā nikkhantā'ti tesaṃ laddhi.

examples.text: tena kho pana samayena dhanañ'jāni brāhmaṇo bahinagare gāvo goṭṭhe duhāpeti.
assosi kho saṅgāravo māṇavo dhanañ'jāniyā brāhmaṇiyā evaṃ vācaṃ bhāsamānāya. sutvā dhanañ'jāniṃ brāhmaṇiṃ etadavoca, avabhūtā'va ayaṃ dhanañ'jānī brāhmaṇī, parabhūtā'va ayaṃ dhanañ'jānī brāhmaṇī

34552.commentary: (SNPa) jātitthaddho nāma yo, ahaṃ jātisampanno'ti mānaṃ janetvā tena thaddho vātapūritabhastā viya uddhumāto hutvā na kassaci onamati. esa nayo dhanagottatthaddhesu.

examples.text: jātitthaddho dhanatthaddho, gottatthaddho ca yo naro, saññātiṃ atimaññeti, taṃ parābhavato mukhaṃ.

34553.grammar: ind, adv, comp, acc sg of dhanattha

examples.text: yaññ'atthaṃ vā dhan'atthaṃ vā, ye hanāma mayaṃ pure, avase taṃ bhayaṃ hoti, vedhanti vilapanti ca.
magadhesu aṅgesu ca satthavāhā, āropayitvā paṇiyaṃ puthuttaṃ, te yāmase sindhusovīrabhūmiṃ, dhan'atthikā uddayaṃ patthayānā.
na so muddhaṃ pajānāti, kuhako so dhan'atthiko, muddhani muddhapāte vā, ñāṇaṃ tassa na vijjati.

34557.meaning1: wealth and grain; material and agricultural resources

examples.text: ye'pi te, mahārāja, khattiyamahāsālā aḍḍhā mahaddhanā mahābhogā pahūtajātarūparajatā pahūtavitt'ūpakaraṇā pahūtadhanadhaññā, tesam'pi jātānaṃ n'atthi aññatra jarāmaraṇā.

34558.commentary: (SNa) sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā'ti sabbena sakena'pi attanā'pi saddhiṃ yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo nāma, ayaṃ appamattako aparādho.

examples.text: appamattako ayaṃ kali, yo akkhesu dhanaparājayo, sabbassā'pi sahā'pi attanā, ayam'eva mahantataro kali, yo sugatesu manaṃ padosaye.

34559.meaningLit: protector of wealth; guardian of treasure

examples.text: dhanapālo nāma kuñjaro, kaṭukabhedano dunnivārayo, baddho kabaḷaṃ na bhuñjati, sumarati nāgavanassa kuñjaro.

34560.meaningLit: protector of wealth; guardian of treasure

34562.meaning1: provided money; gave finance; provided financial support (to)

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, rājā khattiyo muddh'ābhisitto tassa purisassa dhanam'anuppadāsi, iminā tvaṃ, ambho purisa, dhanena attanā ca jīvāhi, mātāpitaro ca posehi, puttadārañ'ca posehi, kamm'ante ca payojehi, samaṇabrāhmaṇesu uddh'aggikaṃ dakkhiṇaṃ patiṭṭhāpehi sovaggikaṃ sukhavipākaṃ saggasaṃvattanikan'ti.

34563.meaning1: gives money; provides financial support (to); makes funds available (for)
34563.commentary: (DNa) anuppadetū'ti dinne appahonte puna aññam'pi bījañ'ca bhattañ'ca kasi-upakaraṇabhaṇḍañ'ca sabbaṃ detū'ti attho.

examples.text: mā ca te, tāta, vijite adhammakāro pavattittha. ye ca te, tāta, vijite adhanā assu, tesañ'ca dhanam'anuppadeyyāsi.

saṃvijjati kho pana, bhante, imasmiṃ rājakule pahūtaṃ hiraññasuvaṇṇaṃ bhūmigatañ'c'eva vehāsaṭṭhañ'ca, yena mayaṃ pahoma āgate paccatthike dhanena upalāpetuṃ. tesam'pi, bhante, dhanayuddhānaṃ n'atthi gati n'atthi visayo adhivattamāne jarāmaraṇe.
dhi'r'atthu taṃ dhanalābhaṃ, yasalābhañ'ca brāhmaṇa, yā vutti vinipātena, adhammacaraṇena vā.
atha kho, bho, te cha khattiyā ekam'antaṃ apakkamma evaṃ samacintesuṃ, ime kho brāhmaṇā nāma dhanaluddhā, yaṃnūna mayaṃ mahāgovindaṃ brāhmaṇaṃ dhanena sikkheyyāmā'ti.
kassapassa, bhikkhave, bhagavato arahato sammāsambuddhassa brahmadatto nāma brāhmaṇo pitā ahosi. dhanavatī nāma brāhmaṇī mātā ahosi janetti. tena kho pana, bhikkhave, samayena kikī nāma rājā ahosi.

34571.synonym: aḍḍha, aḍḍhī, adalidda, adaḷidda, dhana, bhogavant, bhogī, mahaddhana, vittavant, sadhana

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, āvuso, puriso daliddo'va samāno aḍḍhavādaṃ vadeyya, adhano'va samāno dhanavāvādaṃ vadeyya, abhogo'va samāno bhogavāvādaṃ vadeyya.

34572.meaning2: taking money; going to take money

examples.text: attahetu parahetu, dhanahetu ca yo naro, sakkhipuṭṭho musā brūti, taṃ jaññā vasalo iti.

34574.meaning1: takes as one's possession; treasures; considers to be of value

examples.text: imaṃ ce tumhe, bhikkhave, diṭṭhiṃ evaṃ parisuddhaṃ evaṃ pariyodātaṃ allīyetha kelāyetha dhanāyetha mamāyetha, api nu me tumhe, bhikkhave, kull'ūpamaṃ dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājāneyyātha nittharaṇ'atthāya no gahaṇ'atthāyā'ti?

34576.commentary: (THIa) dhanikapurisapātabahulamhī'ti iṇāyikānaṃ purisānaṃ adhipatanabahule bahūhi iṇāyikehi abhibhavitabbe.

examples.text: kadā iṇ'aṭṭo'va daliddako nidhiṃ, ārādhayitvā dhanikehi pīḷito, tuṭṭho bhavissaṃ adhigamma sāsanaṃ, mah'esino taṃ nu kadā bhavissati.

34577.meaning1: family name; example of a low name

examples.text: ettha ca vaggānaṃ dutiyacatutthā dhanitā'ti'pi vuccanti, itare sithilā'ti.

34580.meaning1: name of a monk infamous for the second pārājika

examples.text: ajinamhi haññate dīpi, nāgo dantehi haññate, dhanamhi dhanino hanti, aniketam'asanthavaṃ, phalī ambo aphalo ca, te satthāro ubho mama.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammo dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
dhanumhā ca āpaccayo hoti samās'ante. gāṇḍīvo dhanu yassa so'yaṃ gāṇḍīvadhanvā.
yāni kho pana tāni āraññakāni sen'āsanānī'ti āraññakaṃ nāma sen'āsanaṃ pañcadhanusatikaṃ pacchimaṃ.

ahosiṃ ahaṃ, bho raṭṭhapāla, vīsativass'uddesiko'pi paṇṇavīsativass'uddesiko'pi hatthismim'pi katāvī assasmim'pi katāvī rathasmim'pi katāvī dhanusmim'pi katāvī tharusmim'pi katāvī ūrubalī bāhubalī alam'atto saṅgām'āvacaro.

yathā, mahārāja, mahiyā rājaputtānaṃ hatthi-assaratha-dhanu-tharu-lekha-muddā-sikkhā-khagga-manta-suti-sammuti-yuddha-yujjhāpana-kiriyā karaṇīyā, avasesānaṃ puthu-vessa-suddānaṃ kasi vaṇijjā gorakkhā karaṇīyā

34590.meaning1: toy bow; game of bows and arrows

examples.text: sa kho so, bhikkhave, kumāro vuddhim'anvāya indriyānaṃ paripākam'anvāya yāni tāni kumārakānaṃ kīḷāpanakāni tehi kīḷati, seyyath'idaṃ, vaṅkakaṃ ghaṭikaṃ mokkhacikaṃ ciṅgulakaṃ patt'āḷhakaṃ rathakaṃ dhanukaṃ.

puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu asicammaṃ gahetvā, dhanukalāpaṃ sannayhitvā, ubhatobyūḷhaṃ saṅgāmaṃ pakkhandanti usūsu'pi khippamānesu, sattīsu'pi khippamānāsu, asīsu'pi vijjotalantesu.
asi ca cammañ'ca asicammaṃ, dhanu ca kalāpo ca dhanukalāpaṃ, hatthī ca asso ca hatthi-assaṃ, ratho ca pattiko ca rathapattikaṃ. evaṃ sen'aṅg'atthe.
tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, evarūpo javo ahosi, seyyathā'pi nāma daḷhadhammā dhanuggaho sikkhito katahattho kat'ūpāsano lahukena asanena appakasirena tiriyaṃ tālacchāyaṃ atipāteyya.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, cattāro daḷhadhammā dhanuggahā susikkhitā katahatthā kat'ūpāsanā catuddisā ṭhitā assu.

34596.meaning1: enclosure of bows; encircling wall of bows
34596.meaning2: enclosure of bows; encircling wall of bows
34596.commentary: (DNa) dhanupākāran'ti paṭhamaṃ tāva hatthikumbhena kumbhaṃ paharante parikkhipāpesuṃ, tato asse gīvāya gīvaṃ paharante, tato rathe āṇikoṭiyā āṇikoṭiṃ paharante, tato yodhe bāhunā bāhuṃ paharante. tesaṃ pariyante koṭiyā koṭiṃ paharamānāni dhanūni parikkhipāpesuṃ. iti samantā yojanappamāṇaṃ ṭhānaṃ satt'āhaṃ sannāhagavacchikaṃ viya katvā ārakkhaṃ saṃvidahiṃsu. taṃ sandhāya vuttaṃ, dhanupākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā'ti.

examples.text: atha kho kosinārakā mallā bhagavato sarīrāni satt'āhaṃ sandh'āgāre sattipañjaraṃ karitvā dhanupākāraṃ parikkhipāpetvā naccehi gītehi vāditehi mālehi gandhehi sakkariṃsu garuṃ kariṃsu mānesuṃ pūjesuṃ.

te evarūpāya tiracchānavijjāya micchājīvena jīvitaṃ kappenti, seyyath'idaṃ… usulakkhaṇaṃ dhanulakkhaṇaṃ āvudhalakkhaṇaṃ itthilakkhaṇaṃ purisalakkhaṇaṃ kumāralakkhaṇaṃ kumārilakkhaṇaṃ dāsalakkhaṇaṃ dāsilakkhaṇaṃ
atha kho, ānanda, rañño mahāsudassanassa etadahosi, yaṃnūn'āhaṃ imāsu tāl'antarikāsu dhanusate dhanusate pokkharaṇiyo māpeyyan'ti.

34599.meaning1: distinguished by (the mark of a) bow, spear, stake, etc.
